limitations: TLS uses fixture certificates; no public certificate issuance or public DNS proof.

In-place single-file bind writes provide bounded external-conflict detection, not atomicity against concurrent external writers.
These are backend proxy lifecycle fixtures, separate from complete API/browser import lifecycle evidence.
